title: vaultRecipe
responsibility: Validates a signed per-site Credential Vault login recipe and computes its review digest.

inputs.name: vaultRecipe.input
inputs.description: Untrusted recipe JSON, validated against the recipe schema.

inputs.name: vaultRecipe.signed
inputs.description: Untrusted review envelope JSON: site, revision, digest, reviewer, review time and Ed25519 signature.

inputs.name: vaultRecipe.reviewers
inputs.description: Trusted reviewer ids with their Ed25519 public keys.

inputs.name: vaultRecipe.now
inputs.description: Current time in Unix milliseconds. Defaults to Date.now().

inputs.name: reviewSigningInput.review
inputs.description: Review fields without the signature and reviewer.

outputs.name: recipeSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema of a site recipe, including the action and browser teardown checks.

outputs.name: recipeReview
outputs.description: Zod schema of a recipe review envelope.

outputs.name: vaultRecipe
outputs.description: The normalized recipe, its digest, the grouped digest prefix for Harness iOS and the review.

outputs.name: recipeDigest
outputs.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical recipe JSON.

outputs.name: digestDisplay
outputs.description: The first 16 hex digits in four groups of four.

outputs.name: reviewSigningInput
outputs.description: Canonical JSON bytes of the vault-recipe-review statement that the reviewer signs.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the recipe or review is invalid, for another digest, stale, or not signed by a trusted reviewer.
